# CareGraph benchmark — ASK step under noise (simulation)

*Generated by `npx tsx scripts/benchmark.ts` · 5,000 synthetic cases per scenario · seeded and reproducible.*

**What this measures:** how well each questioning policy reaches the same triage decision as an oracle that knows every true fact, when the worker's report is incomplete and answers can be "don't know" or wrong. Emergencies (oracle) are 12.7% of cases.

**What it does not measure:** clinical accuracy of the protocol itself (the oracle uses the same protocol), or real-world speech. It isolates the *questioning and uncertainty* behaviour.

## Scenario: clean — "don't know" 0.0%, wrong answers 0.0%, spontaneous recall 70.0%

| Policy | Questions | Same as oracle | Under-triage | **Missed emergencies** | Over-triage |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| **CareGraph** (value of information + safety shield + escalation under uncertainty) | 3.50 | 95.6% | 3.4% | **0.8%** | 1.0% |
| Ablation: CareGraph without escalation under uncertainty | 3.50 | 95.6% | 3.4% | **0.8%** | 1.0% |
| Ablation: same number of questions, chosen at random | 3.50 | 81.2% | 18.2% | **62.2%** | 0.6% |
| Full checklist (asks every question) | 6.00 | 95.7% | 3.3% | **0.8%** | 1.0% |
| Danger signs only (no questions) | 0.00 | 69.1% | 30.9% | **78.8%** | 0.0% |

CareGraph uncertainty flag: raised on 0.0% of cases · agreement with oracle when confident **95.6%** vs when flagged **0.0%**.

## Decision latency (per agent turn: risk model + rules + question selection)

p50 **0.04 ms**, p95 **0.10 ms** over 180,922 turns (Node v25.9.0, single thread).

## Simulation assumptions (demo values — replace with country data)

- Latent condition mix: normal 70%, gestational hypertension 18%, severe hypertension 8%, antepartum haemorrhage 3%, eclampsia 1%.
- Symptom probabilities by condition and BP ranges: see `scripts/benchmark.ts` (`P_SYMPTOM`, `BP`).
- BP measured with ±5 mmHg error; worker kit: BP monitor + thermometer (no dipstick).
- Oracle = same protocol with complete true facts. Missed emergency = oracle EMERGENCY but decision PRIORITY or lower.
